Method of Attack: Accidentally collected data entered in password fields due to a bug in the Mixpanel SDK
Collected data inside hidden fields and password inputs
Bug caused by React.js placing copies of hidden and password field values into input element attributes, which Autotrack then collected
Impacted Systems: Web and mobile apps using Mixpanel SDKs with Autotrack
Attack Vector: Mixpanel SDK Autotrack collecting input field attributes including hidden and password fields
Method of Attack: Bug in Mixpanel Autotrack SDK caused collection of sensitive data from password and hidden fields
